scope: Two owner-authorized TEST accounts; read-only DEV diagnostics. APK/device installation was reported by the coordinating agent, not performed by this review.

readiness.uiMessage: Stanje slanja na telefon još nije potvrđeno.
readiness.explanation: The global readiness receipt has expired. Phone permission and an active bound registration do not refresh or prove transport delivery.

scheduler.behavior: Calls the existing push transport only while matching unstarted PUSH deliveries or live attempts exist. SQL cron success does not imply an Edge HTTP call.

insertWake.condition: An inserted row has channel PUSH and state CREATED

transport.sourceBehavior: EXPO_PUSH_TRANSPORT_ENABLED gates tick. A disabled tick returns before database/provider I/O. An enabled successful global tick records TICK_OK; a single-target operation does not fabricate global readiness.

emulator.finding: No new registration is expected through the present client on an Android emulator.
emulator.dependencyEvidence: Installed expo-device Android DeviceModule.kt exposes isDevice as !isRunningOnEmulator.
emulator.bootstrap: PushRuntime reconciles/rotates an already bound session device; initial registration is an explicit settings action. Emulator UNSUPPORTED prevents either native token path.

conclusion: The stale readiness UI is consistent with an idle work-driven scheduler. No failed or missing scheduler/configuration was established. Current provider delivery and the live transport-enabled flag remain unproven until an authorized real event exercises the existing path.
nextScopedObservation: After the coordinator confirms an actual Application or Selection, read only notification event/delivery/attempt outcome and time for these two recipients, then inspect aggregate push HTTP status and readiness. Do not create a synthetic delivery, invoke a write-capable tick/probe, alter freshness, add polling, or expose payload/token/session identifiers.
privacy: No push tokens, worker keys, Vault values, credentials, message bodies, session IDs or provider ticket IDs were returned or saved. Configuration was evaluated server-side into booleans only.
